title: Pill Refinement
description: The true peak of cultivation slop! Pill Refinement. The boost to every MC's journey! So why not bring some to your journey!
body:
# Pill Refinement

Some might know this from your favorite cultivation slop! Through some sacred poisons and herbs in a pot and bang! The ultimate pill. It is my favorite part of any such manhwa, manhua etc. 

As such I bring it to you! In a semi simplified way!


## Pill Cauldron
This is a newly added block called the Pill Cauldron. It is craftable with putting a cauldron over a campfire in any two crafting slots!

This is the central location for **where pills will be made**. It is the final stage and takes the longest 

It has two input slots where you put dust in the first input and a binder in the second input.

(Side Note: The Pill Cauldron looks terrible I know! But it will stay as such for quite a bit)


## Mortar and Pestle
This neat block is used to create the new potential dust. These dust will be crafted with all sorts of things.

Having 10 input slots currently. One to side meant for a base dust such as:

**Glowstone dust, Redstone, Gunpowder, Blaze Powder, Sugar**

then 10 slots to throw in ingredients.


## Dust
Now what is dust? Dust are either dust like minecraft as well a few new set custom dusts. 

**Vanilla Dust:**
**Glowstone dust, Redstone, Gunpowder, Blaze Powder, Sugar**

**Modded Dust:**
**Wheat, Cherry, Poison, Six Poisons, Yin Yang, True Death**

## Binder
Now what is a binder? This will stay semi consistent.

They are items that are in lore hold all the dust together into a pill.

**Wheat, Honeycomb, Slime ball, Snowball, Turtle Scute, Phantom Membrane**

## Manuals
Currently we have 4 manuals but most do not have text yet. Simply recipes.

Manuals will be craftable through progress. Needing to craft the previous pills to unlock the next manual.

Currently it is REI compat so you can ignore the manuals.

## Important!!!
Want to recommend your own pill line as well as potential herbs to add in? Use the link below to do so!

https://forms.gle/roTXA1XLDZLYbs5K8

In the first place, the pills of manhuas, manhwas etc are all based on real medicinal methods some even used in present day. I am a westerner so my understanding on such is pretty minute. I will, however, be using this to my advantage to use some creative liberty but I do also want to learn about more on that topic to potentially add onto what I am making.


## Credit
I am still using Kaupenjoe's tutorial on 1.21 Fabric modding lol. I recommend it!
